facts: Clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft Word in pure Rust
Reads/writes .docx, imports Word 97-2003 .doc, exports PDF
Estimated 88% of Word's ribbon features; alpha status
Windows (.msi), macOS, Linux, FreeBSD and a WebAssembly browser version
Agent control via CLI/MCP; dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0
